Hi Alice, Samir, BluePeak Ops —

Thanks again for signing up for our evening showcase next week. A couple of prospects across EAS/retail/fintech asked for an evening slot and I want to consolidate so we can run a single 60-minute session (brief product tour + tailored breakout time).

Proposed consolidated windows (all in PT):
- Option A: Tue 11 May — 17:30–18:30 PT (feature + Q&A)
- Option B: Wed 12 May — 18:00–19:00 PT (demo + breakout)
- Fallback: Thu 13 May — 17:30–18:30 PT (if attendance conflicts)

Action items for you: can you reply with which option works best? If none, please paste 2–3 local time windows and we’ll map them. I attached a short agenda and an availability matrix to make this easier.

We’ll keep the session fairly focused: 20m product + 25m customer-specific walkthroughs (two breakouts) + 15m close and next steps.

Thanks — hope one of these fits.

Sergio Alvarez
